segments.name: Americas
segments.description: Supplies fabrication technology equipment and consumables to industrial customers across North America and South America through direct and distributor channels.
segments.evidence: These segments consist of the "Americas," which includes operations in North America and South America, and "EMEA & APAC," which includes Europe, the Middle East, India, Africa and Asia Pacific.

segments.name: EMEA & APAC
segments.description: Serves industrial customers in Europe, the Middle East, India, Africa and Asia Pacific with equipment and consumables sold directly and through distributors.
segments.evidence: We report results in two reportable segments: Americas and EMEA & APAC.

revenueModel.text: Distributors and direct salespeople sell fabrication technology equipment, consumables, gas control equipment, robotics and digital solutions to industrial end users.
revenueModel.evidence: Our sales channels include both independent distributors and direct salespeople that, depending on geography and end market, sell our products to our end users.
